M8_ordinary_seed0_expanded.scientific_scope: M8 paired same-data arms; pi+balanced-assignment bundle, not isolated pi causality; old DEV reused

v2.seed_scope: Different extra-query initialization and training RNG, shared pretrained95-parent generator; not independent backbone pretraining
v2.bootstrap_scope: Resample parents, average target conditions and observed seeds within each parent; conditional on these seeds and reused DEV, no selection correction or final-test claim

expanded.seed_scope: Different extra-query initialization and training RNG, shared pretrained95-parent generator; not independent backbone pretraining
expanded.bootstrap_scope: Resample parents, average target conditions and observed seeds within each parent; conditional on these seeds and reused DEV, no selection correction or final-test claim

cost_scope: Conservative sum of serial job outer times including CPU work and failures; nested timings not added

policy.parent_rule: All targets, views and trajectories inherit the parent role. Role reservation is permanent for this experiment family. Old TRAIN is not independent calibration.
policy.initial_generator: fixed last12000 ordinary M4 trained on95 parents, no continued15000 checkpoint

scorer.selection: minimum DEV_SCORE binary cross entropy; earliest tie
scorer.loss: unweighted BCE on actual unfiltered generated candidates

policy.calibration: positive scalar temperature minimizing candidate BCE; only after generator/scorer configuration and checkpoint fixed; report selected-candidate calibration separately
policy.replication_gate: seed0 DEV_SCORE selected validity strictly exceeds both fixed-first and expected-uniform random; Brier below SCORE_TRAIN prevalence predictor; no threshold tuning
policy.mode_distribution: balanced geometric reference clusters, including unknown positives; cluster rule frozen using TRAIN only; not natural occurrence probability
policy.validity: existing tip checker: target3cm, start5mm, unchanged reach events, finite continuous piecewise linear tip path with2cm physical-box margin; not full-arm execution success
policy.oracle_boundary: Geometry labels may produce q targets and evaluation only; neither obstacle truth, target truth, reference paths nor guide/mode IDs enter inference

gate.prospective_dev_policy: Collect last; raw/labels/outcomes remain sealed until a separately frozen prospective evaluation protocol. Not a tuning pool or OOD.

data_reservation.note: Prospective model-role reservation after collection QA, not an untouched final test.
